title: Runbook metadata sidecar (aiops.runbooks/v1)
description: Machine-readable metadata for entries in docs/known-issues/, docs/procedures/ and docs/services/. The docs stay the human source of truth and keep their format; each documented entry carries one HTML-comment marker `<!-- runbook: RB-XXX -->` directly above it, and aiops/runbooks.yml is the sidecar keyed by that id. Cross-file consistency (marker present, tier/automatable rules, action references) is enforced by aiops/tools/lint.py, not by this schema.

source.description: Repo-relative Markdown file holding the human runbook. The marker comment for this id must appear in it exactly once.

tier.description: Blast radius of the scenario the runbook handles (aiops-roadmap.md 'Blast-radius tiers'), i.e. of the hardest thing it touches, not of the diagnosis.

automatable.description: Highest autonomy the runbook may EVER be run with. none = human only (diagnosis may still be automated via `diagnostics`). Default for everything is none; auto additionally requires `idempotency_proof`, tier <= T1, and remediation actions whose own max_autonomy is auto.

maturity.description: curated = the linked doc is a real procedure; stub = the alert path needs a runbook id today but the doc is only the nearest related gotcha (tracked in open-questions.md).

preconditions.description: Facts that must hold before acting (read by a human or the diagnosis session; machine-checkable ones also appear as action guards).

diagnostics.description: T0 registry actions that gather evidence for this runbook.

remediation.description: Registry actions that perform the fix. Must be non-empty iff automatable != none; each action's tier must be <= this runbook's tier.

verify.description: How to confirm the problem is gone. `command` is a read-only shell snippet (lint rejects mutating verbs); `action` names a T0 registry action whose result is the check.

idempotency_proof.description: Repo path of the playbook/role whose re-run safety justifies automatable: auto. Absent for everything else.

basis.description: recurrence = chosen for how often the class recurs in docs/incidents/ + known-issues; critical-path = chosen because a critical alert path needs a runbook_id; both = either alone would have selected it.
